items.title: one of the best stories out there
items.summary: this game never fails to surprise me daily with how story-rich & amazing it is. i have logged on consecutively for about 100+ days now, & the game will always make me feel welcome with the events, gacha system & story given to us. i can’t wait to see where this game ends up, & i hope it gets the recognition it deserves soon. i pray that after the 2.5 anniversary event that included saya, that we’ll be able to get even more content thanks to the game hopefully receiving a ton of money & recognition 🤍
items.author: tawil lover

items.title: Game is crashing every 5 to 10 minutes
items.summary: Love this, absolutely love it. But it keeps crashing. I’m using an older iPad but come on, it’s not a very graphic intensive game, not too much happening at one time. The cinstsnt crashing makes it hard to keep playing
